notes.title: Release
notes.notes:
We decided to leave the Early Access version. 

During the development we realized that we would like to focus more on the museum. However, since this significantly extends the development time, we would like to implement this in with a sequel and end the development on this part. 
This version will be the prologue. Since we are aiming for a full version with the successor, there will be no Early Access phase for it.

Every supporter of this project will receive a free copy of the successor as a thank you and other benefits when it is released.
 
Thank you for your support. 
We will keep you updated about the development.
